messages:
Reese: FYI I'm going to propose we ship the new `debug-digest` sampler flag to reduce full request dumps while keeping small inspect payloads for quick debugs. aims: lower quota + keep PII redaction defaults. thoughts?

Maria: love the idea. can you sketch expected telemetry changes? curious about token/quota delta and console UX.

Reese: rough numbers: 95% of requests become 1-2KB digest instead of full body -> estimated 6-8x quota reduction for sampled logs. will confirm with perf run.

Ankit: from console pov we need a toggle that shows "digest-only" vs "full-inspect" and a per-tenant override. Also add an indicator next to traces that shows which fields were redacted.

Sasha: two quick edgecases: (1) function/tool call outputs often contain structured JSON with email/name keys — need schema-aware redaction. (2) embeddings: do we ever want to keep raw text for embedding failures?

Jamal: +1 on schema-aware. for attachments (images/base64) digest should never store raw blobs. we should drop attachments and store metadata: {mime, size, sha256}.

Erica: for PII we could pseudonymize high-risk fields with HMAC(key per-tenant) instead of blanking. keeps deduping and debugging while protecting data. key rotation implications?

Reese: good call. propose default behavior: redact emails/phones/creditcards; pseudonymize identifiers (user_id, account_id) with hmac. keep hashes in digest. rotation: include key-kid in header so we can re-hash historic digests progressively.

Ankit: rollout UX: feature flag `debug_digest.v1` behind a console slider + staged percent rollout (5,25,75,100). need metrics: `logging.digest.sample_rate`, `logging.inspect.unmask_requests`, `logging.digest.redaction_errors`.

Reese: here's the tentative flag config we discussed:
```yaml
feature: debug_digest.v1
stages:
  - pct: 5
    duration: 1d
  - pct: 25
    duration: 2d
  - pct: 75
    duration: 3d
  - pct: 100
rules:
  - if route.tags contains "internal-debug": pct:100
  - tenant.allowlist overrides pct
```

Maria: can we add a breakglass path? ops should be able to temporarily flip a request to "full-inspect" with RBAC and an audit log.

Jamal: agreed. breakglass should be rate-limited and require justification. store reason + actor in audit event.

Sasha: how do we surface redaction provenance in the UI? small idea: tooltip on each redacted field: "redacted (pattern=email) — hmac:kid=2026-03" so SREs know why.

Erica: plus, add an opt-in for customers doing compliance audits to export full-inspect bundles via a secure S3 job (requires legal approval + retention TTL).

Reese: ops-bot will run the canary _now_ on staging with 5% for the sample routes. @ops-bot can you post a canary summary when done?

ops-bot: canary started: debug_digest.v1 at 5% on staging. will report in ~30m with metrics: digest_rate, redact_fail_rate, avg_payload_size. :robot_face:

Maria: one more: telemetry dashboard widgets should show expected cost delta and a preview sample size (we can show anonymized digests). helps PMs sell it.

Ankit: agree. also add alert: if redact_fail_rate > 0.1% for 15m -> auto-pause rollout and notify #eng-oncall.

Reese: action items: (1) implement sampler + schema-based redactor (ankit/jamal) (2) HMAC pseudonymization impl + key-kid headers (erica) (3) console toggle + rollout UI + preview widgets (maria) (4) ops canary + alerts (reese/ops).

Jamal: I'll start a small PoC for attachments metadata only. linking design doc draft: https://redwood.dev/internal/logging/debug-digest (WIP).

Sasha: ping me for the structured-logs tests — I have weird production examples that broke earlier redactors.

Reese: perfect. let's reconvene after first canary summary. thanks all :thumbsup:
